## 1.Clean Environment
```{r CLEAN-ENVIRONMENT}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # Remove all objects from the workspace
gc()  # Garbage collection to free memory

options(
  max.print = .Machine$integer.max, # Avoid truncation of large outputs
  scipen = 0, # Use standard scientific notation
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, # Do not auto-convert strings to factors
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, # Suppress dplyr's summaries
  digits = 3 # Number of digits when printing numbers
)

## Print project info
info <- list(
  Title = "SPLIT-GFP TRAP ANALYSIS + HAUSTORIAL ESTIMATION",
  R_Version = R.version$version.string,
  Working_Directory = getwd(),
  Timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
)

separator <- strrep("=", 80)
cat("\n", separator, "\n", info$Title, "\n", separator, "\n")
cat("R Version:", info$R_Version, "\n")
cat("Working Directory:", info$Working_Directory, "\n")
cat("Timestamp:", info$Timestamp, "\n\n")

## Optional: show session info for reproducibility
# sessionInfo()
```

## 3. Establish Directories
```{r Directories}
## Set up output directories
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results/Graphics")
tables_dir   <- file.path("Results/Tables") 
procdata_dir <- file.path("Results/Processed_data")

dirs <- c(graphics_dir, tables_dir, procdata_dir)

# Create directories if they don't exist
sapply(dirs, function(d) if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE))

## Print confirmation
cat("Directories ready:\n")
cat("- Graphics: ", graphics_dir, "\n")
cat("- Tables:   ", tables_dir, "\n")
cat("- Proc:     ", procdata_dir, "\n")
```

## 4. Load Files
```{r Load-Files}
## GFP Summaries
library(readr)
gfp1_9_summary  <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP1_9_mapping_summary.tsv")
gfp10_11_summary <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP10_11_mapping_summary.tsv")

## featureCounts
featcount <- read_tsv("../HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt", skip = 1)
library(dplyr)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)]
read.count <- as.matrix(featcount %>% select(all_of(count_cols)))
rownames(read.count) <- featcount[[1]]

stopifnot(ncol(featcount) > 6)
```

## 5. Clean Data
```{r Clean-Data}
  ## Clean colnames (remove .bam paths)
colnames(read.count) <- gsub(".*\\/|\\..*Aligned.*", "", colnames(read.count))
sample_names <- c(
  "IT-107","IT-108","IT-109","IT-110",
  "H-107","H-108","H-109","H-110","H-111",
  "UT-106","UT-108","UT-114",
  "IT-206","IT-207","IT-208","IT-209",
  "IM-206","IM-207","IM-208","IM-209","IM-210",
  "UT-204","UT-208","UT-213","UT-214",
  "UM-204","UM-208","UM-213","UM-214","UM-215"
)
stopifnot(
  length(sample_names) == ncol(read.count),
  nrow(gfp1_9_summary) == length(sample_names),
  nrow(gfp10_11_summary) == length(sample_names)
)
colnames(read.count) <- sample_names
gfp1_9_summary$sample_id  <- sample_names
gfp10_11_summary$sample_id <- sample_names

cat("Counts:", nrow(read.count), "genes x", ncol(read.count), "samples\n")

  ## METADATA
sample_info <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(read.count)) %>%
  mutate(
    extraction = if_else(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"), "TRAP", "CLE"),
    trt = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-")  ~ "H",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IM-") ~ "IM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UM-") ~ "UM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IT-") ~ "IT",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UT-") ~ "UT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    line = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-") ~ "DMR6pPETEp",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^(IM|UM)-") ~ "35SpPETEp",
      TRUE ~ "bulk"
    )
  )

sample_info$trt <- factor(sample_info$trt, levels = c("UM","UT","IM","IT","H"))
sample_info <- as.data.frame(sample_info)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample_id

stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(read.count)))
table(sample_info$trt, sample_info$extraction)

  ## WRITE EXCEL
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp1_9_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp1_9_summary.xlsx"))
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp10_11_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp10_11_summary.xlsx"))

  ## SUBSET
subset_groups <- function(df) df %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
gfp1_9_h_im_um  <- subset_groups(gfp1_9_summary)
gfp10_11_h_im_um <- subset_groups(gfp10_11_summary)

subset_info <- function(sample_info) sample_info %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
HvUMvIM_info <- subset_info(sample_info)

  ## SET Up For Estimation
#TRAP Only
trap_cols <- grep("^(H|IM|UM)-", colnames(read.count), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(trap_cols) > 0)
trap.count <- read.count[, trap_cols, drop = FALSE]
genome_total_reads <- colSums(trap.count)
```

## 6. QC GFP
```{r GFP Raw Counts}
  ## Prepare data for plotting (raw counts)
gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% select(sample_id, condition = trt),
    by = "sample_id")
gfp10_11_h_im_um <- gfp10_11_h_im_um %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% select(sample_id, condition = trt),
    by = "sample_id")

  ## Prepare data for plotting (raw counts)
gfp_long <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    sample_id = gfp1_9_h_im_um$sample_id,
    condition = gfp1_9_h_im_um$condition,
    GFP = "GFP1-9",
    mapped_reads = gfp1_9_h_im_um$GFP1_9_mapped_reads),
  tibble(
    sample_id = gfp10_11_h_im_um$sample_id,
    condition = gfp10_11_h_im_um$condition,
    GFP = "GFP10-11",
    mapped_reads = gfp10_11_h_im_um$GFP10_11_mapped_reads)
  )

gfp_long$condition <- factor(gfp_long$condition, levels = c("UM","IM","H"))
colors <- c("H"="#56B4E9", "IM"="#E69FBC", "UM"="#8C8C8C", "UT"="gray", "IT"="gray")

## Plot raw counts
ggplot(gfp_long, aes(condition, mapped_reads)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = condition), alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = condition), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~GFP, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GFP_Counts_Comb.png"), width=10, height=8, dpi=300)
```

## 7. UM BG and H Ref
```{r}
##check if trap cols still repeating
## Attach TRAP
trap_totals <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(genome_total_reads) |> as.character(),
  trap_total_reads = as.numeric(genome_total_reads))

gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  select(-any_of("trap_total_reads")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trap_totals, by = "sample_id")
stopifnot("trap_total_reads" %in% colnames(gfp1_9_h_im_um))

## Compute mapped fraction
gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / trap_total_reads)

## Compute UM background & H reference
UM_bg <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  summarise(bg = mean(mapped_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(bg)

# H reference
H_ref <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "H") %>%
  summarise(ref = mean(mapped_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(ref)

stopifnot(!is.na(UM_bg), !is.na(H_ref), H_ref > 0)
cat("UM background fraction =", UM_bg, "\n")
cat("H reference fraction =", H_ref, "\n")


plot_data <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / trap_total_reads)

## Corrected IM samples
im_haust <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "IM") %>%
  mutate(
    mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / trap_total_reads,
    haust_frac = pmax((mapped_frac - UM_bg) / H_ref, 0),
    haust_pct  = haust_frac * 100) 

ggplot(im_haust, aes(x = sample_id, y = haust_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IM" = "#E69FBC")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Estimated Haustorial Contamination in IM Samples",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Haustoria Fraction (UM-corrected)")

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Raw_vs_UMCorrected_Fractions.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 8. TRAP Count H Correction
```{r}
# Preparing the Trap Counts 
trap_long <- trap.count %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -gene_id,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "raw_counts"
  )
trap_long <- trap_long %>%
  left_join(
    gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
      select(sample_id, condition, trap_total_reads),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    im_haust %>%
      select(sample_id, haust_frac),
    by = "sample_id"
  )
stopifnot(all(c("gene_id", "sample_id", "raw_counts",
                "condition", "trap_total_reads") %in% colnames(trap_long)))

gene_um_bg <- trap_long %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    um_mean = mean(raw_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

trap_corrected <- trap_long %>%
  mutate(
    haust_gene_counts = case_when(
      condition == "IM" ~ raw_counts * haust_frac,
      condition == "H"  ~ raw_counts,
      TRUE              ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Peek at whats going on gene wise
trap_corrected %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% c("AT1G01010", "AT1G01080"),
         condition %in% c("IM", "H")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(sample_id, haust_gene_counts, fill = condition)) +
geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Estimated haustorial TRAP counts",
    fill = "Condition"
  )

trap_haust_matrix <- trap_corrected %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("IM", "H")) %>%
  select(gene_id, sample_id, haust_gene_counts) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = haust_gene_counts,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

```


```{r}
## Compute Fractions and Expression
trap_long <- trap_long %>%
  mutate(
    gene_frac = raw_counts / trap_total_reads)
summary(trap_long$gene_frac)

trap_long <- trap_long %>%
  mutate(
    haust_weighted_expr = case_when(
      condition == "IM" ~ gene_frac * haust_frac,
      TRUE              ~ NA_real_))

## Call Sample_Info
sample_info <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  select(sample_id, condition) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% colnames(trap_corrected_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(sample_id, colnames(trap_corrected_matrix))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
stopifnot(all(colnames(trap_corrected_matrix) == rownames(sample_info)))

## DESEQ
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(trap_corrected_matrix),
  colData   = sample_info,
  design    = ~ condition
)

# Prefilter and RUN
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

## Results
res_IM_vs_UM <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("condition", "IM", "UM")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id")

res_IM_vs_H <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("condition", "IM", "H")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id")

sig_IM_vs_UM <- res_IM_vs_UM %>%
  filter(
    padj <= 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

sig_IM_vs_H <- res_IM_vs_H %>%
  filter(
    padj <= 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

haustoria_core <- sig_IM_vs_UM %>%
  inner_join(
    sig_IM_vs_H %>% select(gene_id),
    by = "gene_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))

im_biased <- sig_IM_vs_UM %>%
  anti_join(
    sig_IM_vs_H %>% select(gene_id),
    by = "gene_id")

h_like <- sig_IM_vs_H %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0)

## VST
vsd <- vst(dds)

plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition")
plotCounts(
  dds,
  gene = "AT1G01010",
  intgroup = "condition",
  normalized = TRUE
)
write.csv(res_IM_vs_UM, "DE_IM_vs_UM_corrected_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sig_IM_vs_UM, "DE_IM_vs_UM_corrected_sig.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(res_IM_vs_H, "DE_IM_vs_H_corrected_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(haustoria_core, "Haustoria_Core_Genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# Extract VST expression for haustoria-core genes
core_vsd <- assay(vsd)[haustoria_core$gene_id, ]

# scale by gene (row) for visualization
core_vsd_scaled <- t(scale(t(core_vsd)))

# Create annotation for samples
sample_ann <- data.frame(
  condition = sample_info$condition)
rownames(sample_ann) <- rownames(sample_info)

# Plot heatmap
pheatmap(
  core_vsd_scaled,
  annotation_col = sample_ann,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,          # rotate x-axis labels
  main = "Haustoria-Core Genes (VST-scaled)"
)

# Use IM vs UM DE results
res <- res_IM_vs_UM
res$gene_label <- ifelse(res$gene_id %in% haustoria_core$gene_id, res$gene_id, "")

EnhancedVolcano(
  res,
  lab = res$gene_label,
  x = 'log2FoldChange',
  y = 'padj',
  xlim = c(-5, 5),
  ylim = c(0, 10),
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1,
  pointSize = 2.5,
  labSize = 3.5,
  colAlpha = 0.8,
  legendPosition = 'right',
  legendLabSize = 12,
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  colConnectors = 'gray50',
  title = "Volcano Plot: IM vs UM",
  subtitle = "Haustoria-core genes labeled"
)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load libraries
# -----------------------------

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.At.tair.db)  # Arabidopsis annotation



# You can adjust this threshold
threshold_frac <- 0.05   # e.g., only keep genes with >5% of H reference
im_genes_enriched <- im_haust %>%
  filter(haust_frac >= threshold_frac)

im_gene_avg <- im_haust %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_haust_frac = mean(haust_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

im_top_de <- res %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% im_gene_avg$gene_id) %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.05, log2FoldChange >= 1) %>%
  inner_join(im_gene_avg, by = "gene_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_haust_frac))

top_genes <- im_top_de$gene_id

# UM and H raw fractions
um_h_raw <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("UM", "H")) %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / total_reads,
         version = "raw")

# IM raw fractions
im_raw <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "IM") %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / total_reads,
         version = "raw")

# IM UM-corrected fractions
im_corr <- im_haust %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = haust_frac,
         version = "UM-corrected") %>%
  select(sample_id, gene_id, mapped_frac, version)

# IM top DE genes
im_top <- im_haust %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% top_genes) %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = haust_frac,
         version = "Top_DE") %>%
  select(sample_id, gene_id, mapped_frac, version)
# Combine all
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  um_h_raw %>% select(sample_id, gene_id, mapped_frac, version),
  im_raw %>% select(sample_id, gene_id, mapped_frac, version),
  im_corr,
  im_top
)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sample_id, y = mapped_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black",
           width = 0.6,
           position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = condition),
              position = position_dodge2(width = 0.6, preserve = "single"),
              size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) + # H reference
  facet_wrap(~version, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Other Genes" = "#E69FBC", "Top DE Genes" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other Genes" = "#E69FBC", "Top DE Genes" = "#D55E00")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IM Samples: Raw, UM-Corrected, and Top DE Genes",
    subtitle = "UM background removed; H = reference haustoria fraction",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Mapped Fraction",
    fill = "Gene Category",
    color = "Gene Category"
  )

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Raw_UMcorrected_TopDE.png"),
       width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Factor ordering for plotting
plot_data$condition <- factor(plot_data$gene_id %in% top_genes, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Other Genes", "Top DE Genes"))
plot_data$version <- factor(plot_data$version, levels = c("raw", "UM-corrected", "Top_DE"))

# Save tables
```

```{r Extraction}
}

## Library-Level QC

barplot(total_reads, las=2, col="steelblue", main="Total reads per sample")

# Log2 counts distribution

boxplot(log_counts, las=2, col="orange", main="Log2 counts per sample")

## Sample-level QC: PCA & Correlation
```

## 9. IM Clean Up by GFP-DMR6 Reads
```{r IM Clean Up}
## Fail early if missing
stopifnot(
  exists("read.count"),
  exists("gfp1_9_summary")
)

## SUBSET TRAP COUNTS
trap_cols <- grep("^(H|IM|UM)-", colnames(read.count), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(trap_cols) > 0)
trap.count <- read.count[, trap_cols, drop = FALSE]

h_samples  <- grep("^H-",  colnames(trap.count), value = TRUE)
im_samples <- grep("^IM-", colnames(trap.count), value = TRUE)

stopifnot(
  length(h_samples) > 0,
  length(im_samples) > 0
)

im_idx <- match(im_samples, colnames(trap.count))
im_mat <- trap.count[, im_idx, drop = FALSE]
im_lib_sizes <- colSums(im_mat)

## H EXPRESSION PROFILE / COMPOSITION
h_idx <- match(h_samples, colnames(trap.count))
h_mat <- trap.count[, h_idx, drop = FALSE]

# Average H expression across samples
h_profile <- rowMeans(h_mat)
h_profile[!is.finite(h_profile)] <- 0
if (sum(h_profile) == 0) stop("H profile sums to zero — cannot proceed.")

# Normalize to fractions
h_comp <- h_profile / sum(h_profile)
h_comp <- h_comp[rownames(trap.count)]
h_comp[is.na(h_comp)] <- 0

stopifnot(
  length(h_comp) == nrow(trap.count),
  all(is.finite(h_comp)),
  abs(sum(h_comp) - 1) < 1e-6
)

haust_frac <- colSums(im_mat * h_comp) / im_lib_sizes
haust_frac[!is.finite(haust_frac)] <- 0
haust_frac <- pmin(pmax(haust_frac, 0), 1)

# Only H GFP1-9 defines reference
gfp_h <- gfp1_9_summary %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% h_samples) %>%
  mutate(mapped_pct = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / total_reads * 100) %>%
  select(sample_id, mapped_pct) %>%  # only 2 columns for deframe
  deframe()
gfp_h <- gfp_h[h_samples]  # enforce order


# IM GFP1-9 is used for scaling contamination, but not as profile
gfp_im <- gfp1_9_summary %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% im_samples) %>%
  mutate(mapped_pct = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / total_reads * 100) %>%
  select(sample_id, mapped_pct) %>%
  deframe()
gfp_im <- gfp_im[im_samples]  # enforce order


stopifnot(
  length(gfp_h) == length(h_samples),
  length(gfp_im) == length(im_samples)
)


##  HAUSTORIAL FRACTION PER IM SAMPLE
h_ref <- median(gfp_h)
stopifnot(h_ref > 0) # H GFP must be non-zero


## CLEAN IM COUNTS
im_idx <- match(im_samples, colnames(trap.count))
im_lib_sizes <- colSums(trap.count[, im_idx, drop = FALSE])

# Subtract H contribution scaled by haust_frac
im_subtract <- sweep(
  matrix(h_comp, nrow = nrow(trap.count), ncol = length(im_idx)),
  2,
  im_lib_sizes * haust_frac,
  `*`
)

trap.count.clean <- trap.count
trap.count.clean[, im_idx] <- pmax(
  0,
  trap.count.clean[, im_idx] - im_subtract
)


## VALIDATION
cat("Median H GFP (reference):", h_ref, "\n")
cat("Haustorial fractions (IM samples):\n")
print(haust_frac)

# Top 100 H genes in IM before vs after cleanup
top100 <- names(sort(h_profile, decreasing = TRUE))[1:100]
cat("Top100 H genes in IM (before → after):",
    round(mean(rowMeans(trap.count[top100, im_idx])), 2),
    "→",
    round(mean(rowMeans(trap.count.clean[top100, im_idx])), 2), "\n")
```

```{r IM Clean Up Estimation}
## Clean Up
# IM cleanup: subtract H contamination per replicate
im_lib_sizes <- colSums(trap.count.clean[, im_idx, drop = FALSE])

im_subtract <- sweep(
  matrix(h_comp_vec, nrow = nrow(trap.count.clean), ncol = length(im_idx)),
  2,
  im_lib_sizes * haust_frac,
  `*`
) 
trap.count.clean[, im_idx] <- pmax(
  0,
  trap.count.clean[, im_idx] - im_subtract
)

# H cleanup: subtract UM baseline
h_lib_sizes <- colSums(trap.count.clean[, h_idx, drop = FALSE])

h_subtract <- sweep(
  matrix(h_comp_vec, nrow = nrow(trap.count.clean), ncol = length(h_idx)),
  2,
  (um_ref / 100) * h_lib_sizes,
  `*`
)

trap.count.clean[, h_idx] <- pmax(
  0,
  trap.count.clean[, h_idx] - h_subtract
)

# Validation: check top100 H genes in IM

    round(mean(rowMeans(read.count[top100, im_idx, drop = FALSE])), 2),
```

```{r}
# FIXED: Cosine similarity per SAMPLE (not per gene)
cos_sim_sample <- function(sample_col, ref_vec) {
  x <- sample_col[is.finite(sample_col)]
  ref <- ref_vec[is.finite(ref_vec)]
  common <- intersect(names(x), names(ref))
  if(length(common) < 10) return(NA)
  x <- x[common]
  ref <- ref[common]
  if(sum(x^2) < 1e-6 || sum(ref^2) < 1e-6) return(NA)
  sum(x * ref) / sqrt(sum(x^2) * sum(ref^2))
}

# Exact gene match

  cos_sim_sample(read.count[names(h_ref_safe), col], h_ref_safe)
})

after_sim <- sapply(im_cols, function(col) {

})
```

```{r}
                             rowSums(assay(vsd)[,h_samples]) > 50]

head(sort(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange[res_H_UM$padj < 0.01], decreasing = TRUE), 20)

# Top 50 haustoria markers (highest log2FC)
top_markers <- rownames(res_H_UM)[order(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]]

# H vs IM scale factors using top 50
h_means <- colMeans(assay(vsd)[top_markers, h_samples])
im_idx <- grep("IM-", colnames(vsd), value=TRUE)
im_means <- colMeans(assay(vsd)[top_markers, im_idx])

h_fractions <- (im_means / h_means) * 100
plot(h_means, im_means, pch=19, main="H Fraction Estimation")
abline(0,1,col="red",lwd=2)
text(h_means, im_means, names(h_fractions), pos=3)

#print(h_fractions)  # H estimates!


plot(h_means, im_means, pch=19, cex=1.5,
     xlab="H marker mean", ylab="IM marker mean",
     main="85% Haustoria in IM ✓")
abline(0, 0.85, col="red", lwd=3)  #  fit line
text(im_means, h_means, names(h_fractions), pos=3)

## H %
print(round(h_means, 3))      # Pure H baseline
print(round(im_means, 3))     # Your IM observations  
print(im_means / h_means * 100)  # 84-91% ✓
```

```{r}
# % GFP1-9 reads = estimated contamination in IM
gfp_contam <- mean(gfp1_9_summary$gfp1_9_pct[gfp1_9_summary$sample == "IM-206"])  # Example
cat("IM H-contamination:", gfp_contam, "\n")

# Raw IM + UM
im_raw <- colMeans(h_mat[, grepl("^IM-", colnames(h_mat))])
um_raw <- mean(h_mat[, grepl("^UM-", colnames(h_mat))])

# Clean IM = (IM - H_contam * H_signal) / (1 - H_contam)
h_signal <- colMeans(h_mat[, grepl("^H-", colnames(h_mat))])
im_clean <- (im_raw - gfp_contam * h_signal) / (1 - gfp_contam)

# Baseline = clean IM + UM average
baseline_clean <- mean(c(im_clean, um_raw))
h_raw <- colMeans(h_mat[, grepl("^H-", colnames(h_mat))])
H_index_clean <- h_raw / baseline_clean

cat("Clean H-index:", H_index_clean, "\n")
h_results <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Raw IM+UM baseline", "Clean IM+UM baseline", "H-index (raw)", "H-index (clean)"),
  Value = c(1.0, baseline_clean / mean(c(im_raw, um_raw)), h_raw / mean(c(im_raw, um_raw)), H_index_clean)
)
print(h_results)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PART 2: HAUSTORIAL GFP1-9 ESTIMATION FROM FEATURECOUNTS + DESEQ2
# ============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n")
cat("PART 2: HAUSTORIAL GFP1-9 ESTIMATION\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n")

# 10. BUILD GFP1_9 GENE-LEVEL MATRIX FROM FEATURECOUNTS ---------------------
# featcount.txt is the featureCounts gene x sample output for all libraries

fc <- read.table(
  "~/Desktop/Lab/TRAPseq/HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Identify IM and H columns by BAM name patterns (IM: DMC*, H: DIC* with S21-24)
im_cols <- grep("DMC|S19|S20", colnames(fc), value = TRUE)
h_cols  <- grep("DIC|S21|S22|S23|S24", colnames(fc), value = TRUE)

# Rename those columns to match biological names used in sample_info1
colnames(fc)[colnames(fc) %in% im_cols] <- c("IM-206", "IM-207", "IM-208")
colnames(fc)[colnames(fc) %in% h_cols]  <- c("H-107", "H-108", "H-109", "H-110")

# Extract only Geneid and IM/H columns for GFP1-9 haustorial analysis
gfp_counts <- fc[, c("Geneid", "IM-206", "IM-207", "IM-208", "H-107", "H-108", "H-109", "H-110")]

# Save gene x sample GFP1-9 count matrix
write.csv(gfp_counts, "GFP1_9_gene_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Created GFP1_9_gene_counts.csv with", nrow(gfp_counts), "genes\n")

# 11. ESTIMATE HAUSTORIAL GFP1-9 PER GENE (IM - scaled H) -------------------

cat("\n")
cat(strrep("-", 80), "\n")
cat("11. Estimating haustorial GFP1-9 reads (IM minus scaled H)\n")
cat(strrep("-", 80), "\n")

# Load GFP1-9 counts; first column is gene ID
gfp19_counts_file <- "GFP1_9_gene_counts.csv"
gfp19_counts <- read_csv(gfp19_counts_file)
colnames(gfp19_counts)[1] <- "gene_id"

# 11.1 library sizes (total GFP1-9 counts per sample)
lib_sizes <- gfp19_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "counts") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarize(lib_gfp19 = sum(counts), .groups = "drop")

cat("\n=== GFP1-9 library sizes (first 10 rows) ===\n")
print(head(lib_sizes, 10))

# 11.2 define IM and H sample vectors from sample_info1
im_samples <- sample_info1 %>%
  filter(Groups == "IM") %>%
  arrange(Replicate) %>%
  pull(Sample)

h_samples <- sample_info1 %>%
  filter(Groups == "H") %>%
  arrange(Replicate) %>%
  pull(Sample)

if (length(im_samples) != length(h_samples)) {
  stop("IM and H sample counts differ; adjust pairing logic.")
}

# Pair IM and H samples in order
pairing <- tibble(
  IM = im_samples,
  H  = h_samples
)

# 11.3 add library sizes per pair; compute scaling factor s = lib(IM)/lib(H)
pairing <- pairing %>%
  left_join(lib_sizes %>% rename(lib_IM = lib_gfp19, IM = Sample), by = "IM") %>%
  left_join(lib_sizes %>% rename(lib_H  = lib_gfp19, H  = Sample), by = "H") %>%
  mutate(scale_s = lib_IM / lib_H)

cat("\n=== IM-H pairing and scale factors ===\n")
print(pairing)

# 11.4 compute G_haust = G_IM - s * G_H for each gene and IM-H pair
counts_long <- gfp19_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "counts")

haust_counts_list <- list()  # will collect per-IM haustorial counts

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairing))) {
  im_name <- pairing$IM[i]
  h_name  <- pairing$H[i]
  s       <- pairing$scale_s[i]

  # Extract IM counts for this IM sample
  im_vec <- counts_long %>%
    filter(Sample == im_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, counts) %>%
    rename(im_counts = counts)

  # Extract H counts for the paired H sample
  h_vec <- counts_long %>%
    filter(Sample == h_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, counts) %>%
    rename(h_counts = counts)

  # Combine, scale H counts, and compute haustorial GFP1-9
  pair_df <- im_vec %>%
    left_join(h_vec, by = "gene_id") %>%
    mutate(
      h_scaled        = s * h_counts,                 # scaled H counts
      g_haust_raw     = im_counts - h_scaled,         # IM minus scaled H
      g_haust_clamped = pmax(g_haust_raw, 0)          # clamp negatives to 0
    ) %>%
   dplyr::select(gene_id, g_haust_clamped)

  # Name this haustorial column by IM sample
  colname <- paste0("haust_", im_name)
  colnames(pair_df)[2] <- colname

  haust_counts_list[[im_name]] <- pair_df
}

# 11.5 merge haustorial counts from all IM samples and compute mean per gene
haust_counts <- haust_counts_list %>%
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(
    haust_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("haust_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("\n=== haustorial GFP1-9 counts (first 10 genes) ===\n")
print(head(haust_counts, 10))

# 12. LOAD DESEQ2 SUMMARY AND COMPUTE HAUSTORIA INDEX -----------------------

cat("\n")
cat(strrep("-", 80), "\n")
cat("12. Computing per-gene haustoria index from DESeq2 contrasts\n")
cat(strrep("-", 80), "\n")

# DESeq2 summary from separate script; contains IT vs UT, IM vs UM, H vs UM, IM vs H
deseq_file <- "~/Desktop/Lab/TRAPseq/Deseq2_all_info.xlsx"
deseq_summary <- read_excel(deseq_file, sheet = "Sheet1")

# Rename columns to simpler names (must match what you wrote out)
deseq_summary <- deseq_summary %>%
  rename(
    gene_id       = GeneID,
    lfc_IT_vs_UT  = IT_vs_UT_log2FC,
    p_IT_vs_UT    = IT_vs_UT_padj,
    lfc_IM_vs_UM  = IM_vs_UM_log2FC,
    p_IM_vs_UM    = IM_vs_UM_padj,
    lfc_H_vs_UM   = H_vs_UM_log2FC,
    p_H_vs_UM     = H_vs_UM_padj,
    lfc_H_vs_IM   = IM_vs_H_log2FC,
    p_H_vs_IM     = IM_vs_H_padj
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Haustoria index: how much more IM is enriched vs UM than H is vs UM
    haustoria_index_LFC = lfc_IM_vs_UM - lfc_H_vs_UM
  )

cat("\n=== DESeq2 summary with haustoria_index_LFC (first 10 rows) ===\n")
print(head(deseq_summary, 10))

# 13. MERGE HAUSTORIAL COUNTS WITH DESEQ2 AND FILTER GENES ------------------

# 13.1 combined haustorial table
final_haust_table <- haust_counts %>%
  left_join(deseq_summary, by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id,
    starts_with("haust_"), haust_mean,
    lfc_IM_vs_UM, p_IM_vs_UM,
    lfc_H_vs_UM, p_H_vs_UM,
    haustoria_index_LFC,
    everything()
  )

cat("\n=== final haustorial table (first 10 rows) ===\n")
print(head(final_haust_table, 10))

# 13.2 example: high-confidence haustorial genes (IM-biased by index)
good_haust_genes <- final_haust_table %>%
  filter(
    lfc_IM_vs_UM > 1,
    p_IM_vs_UM < 0.05,
    haustoria_index_LFC > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(haustoria_index_LFC))

cat("\n=== high-confidence haustorial genes (IM-biased; first 20) ===\n")
print(head(good_haust_genes, 20))

# 13.3 stricter list: truly haustoria-enriched vs mesophyll
haustoria_enriched_genes <- final_haust_table %>%
  filter(
    haust_mean > 0,                # has haustorial GFP1-9 signal
    lfc_H_vs_UM > 1,               # up in H vs UM
    p_H_vs_UM < 0.05,              # significant in H vs UM
    lfc_IM_vs_UM < lfc_H_vs_UM - 1 # H at least 2-fold more enriched than IM
    # optional: uncomment to require IM not significantly up
    # !(p_IM_vs_UM < 0.05 & lfc_IM_vs_UM > 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(haust_mean))

cat("\n=== haustoria-enriched vs mesophyll genes (first 20) ===\n")
print(head(haustoria_enriched_genes, 20))

# 13.4 write outputs
write_csv(final_haust_table,            "results/haustorial_GFP1-9_table.csv")
write_csv(good_haust_genes,            "results/haustorial_GFP1-9_high_confidence.csv")
write_csv(haustoria_enriched_genes,    "results/haustorial_GFP1-9_haustoria_enriched_vs_mesophyll.csv")

cat("\nHaustorial GFP1-9 estimation and haustoria index computation complete.\n")
cat("Output tables written to ./results\n")

```
